runtimeAndInstallPrerequisites.installation: Extract the entire ZIP to a local folder you control; keep PixelBridge.exe, runtime scripts, Profiles, Assets and text guides together.
runtimeAndInstallPrerequisites.cloud: Saved Edge/Firefox preference in every tier for Xbox and NVIDIA web routes; browsers are installed independently. Firefox Xbox is experimental, requires explicit consent and offers an explicit per-launch Edge fallback. No official Xbox Firefox support or universally faster browser claim.
runtimeAndInstallPrerequisites.lan: Sunshine is not included. Open the official upstream releases page for independent download/verification/install, reuse a user-configured host, or defer. PixelBridge never downloads or invokes a Sunshine installer; it can start/reuse the configured host. No router WAN forwarding or UPnP is required.
runtimeAndInstallPrerequisites.hdmi: Guided supported Windows display/audio settings and user-designated hardware checklists, not automatic TV control. Direct HDMI, wired Moonlight receiver, matched HDMI extender/HDBaseT, or explicitly supported AV-over-IP pair require the user's compatible hardware.
notIncluded: Personal unlocked build or installer wrapper

Manual launching and all five standard native .rmp profiles/common XInput .cfg bindings with standard import/export
Curated descriptions and saved launcher shortcuts
Static disclosed AdGuard affiliate banners on Emulators and Network only; no automatic banner network request, overlay, counter or click gate

documentedNativeProfileTargets.limits: Reference profiles, not actual gameplay/controller certification. Standard native import/export is free; standalone alternatives use their own input menus.

privacyAndSupportFacts.licenseStorage: Minimal key/status remains DPAPI-encrypted for the current Windows user, with unchanged v1.2 entropy/schema/filenames and no key/PII logging.
privacyAndSupportFacts.network: No analytics, startup task, tray daemon or automatic banner network request. User-initiated provider/upstream clicks, local health checks and consented paid verification use their respective endpoints.
privacyAndSupportFacts.sunshineBoundary: No reading/importing of host configuration, apps list, credentials, certificates or pairing state. Can start/reuse user-configured host, never downloads/invokes its installer.
privacyAndSupportFacts.networkChanges: No required WAN forwarding/UPnP, hotspot, automatic VPN/router/TV-network changes or disabling of security tools. Scoped optional Private-profile firewall change needs preview, consent and elevation.
privacyAndSupportFacts.closingApp: B/Esc closes only PixelBridge, not Sunshine, browsers or games; controller navigation affects only its foreground main window.
privacyAndSupportFacts.support: General studio support: /support/. Purchase help: the customer's Gumroad receipt.

paidLicensePolicy.purchase: One-time purchase for Supporter and Pro; matching v1.2 purchases remain eligible with unchanged product IDs and approved routes
paidLicensePolicy.activation: Matching genuine Gumroad receipt key, official HTTPS API, increment_uses_count=false. Failed first activation never grants access.
paidLicensePolicy.onlineRecheck: Weekly while open or on a later launch
paidLicensePolicy.offline: Previously verified purchases remain usable indefinitely offline; transient network errors retain prior extras with stale/offline status.
paidLicensePolicy.confirmedInvalidation: Paid extras only; never essential launching, controls, mappings, HDMI or retained library/variant files.
paidLicensePolicy.upgrade: Retain %LOCALAPPDATA%\PixelBridge under the same Windows user; DPAPI/license format and existing settings continuity are preserved.
paidLicensePolicy.acceptanceGap: Synthetic upgrade fixtures do not establish real-customer activation acceptance.
